evidence: Cash, cash equivalents and short-term marketable securities were $242.5 billion at June 30, 2026.

counter_evidence: Long-term debt reached $98.2 billion by June 2026 and another $25.0 billion of notes were issued in August.

evidence: Base-case DCF value of approximately $339 per share is close to the $341.84 GOOGL market price.

Cloud growth and margin expansion provide a credible path to exceed embedded expectations.
counter_evidence: The market already capitalizes much of the AI and Cloud success; probability-weighted value offers only about 8% upside.
Displayed P/E near 17x is distorted by very large unrealized equity gains; a core operating earnings check is materially more expensive.
Base value depends on FCF margin recovering to 24% after an unprecedented capex cycle.
missing_data: Post-Q2 2026 ATM issuance and fully diluted share count
Reliable split of recurring maintenance capex and discretionary growth capex

evidence: Bull-case value of approximately $668 offers about 95% upside if Alphabet converts AI distribution and infrastructure into durable high-margin cash flow.

counter_evidence: Bear-case value of approximately $132 implies about 61% downside, greater than the probability-weighted expected upside.

missing_data: Waymo standalone economics and external valuation durability
